name: Paco Ruelas
bio:
Paco Ruelas is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in San Jose, United States, specialising in realism and black & gray styles. His incredible attention to detail and artistic mastery are evident in every tattoo piece he crafts, making him a highly sought-after artist with bookings available until September 2022. Please note, he prefers communication via text and requires a non-refundable deposit to secure an appointment at his studio, Always Cre8 Ta2studio.
